transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the Atlas toolkit release scheduled for next Friday. As I understand it, the engineering team plans to publish it in our public repository, and it includes source code, documentation, and a sample training package for external developers. Before I can give my final legal approval, I need to confirm that all pre-release conditions have been completed and documented across the board -- open-source, commercial, export-control, and privacy counsel all need to update the checklist for our weekly product-release legal gate. Can each of you share where things stand on your end?

This means the combined distribution must use the GPLv3 license and include corresponding source and attribution notices. I have not yet updated the release ticket with this finding, so this condition remains outstanding.

transcript.text: I need to flag a commercial licensing issue. That agreement prohibits public release of the connector without written customer consent. I have not yet added this contract restriction to the release checklist, so this condition remains outstanding on my end.
